purpose: Freeze the protocol for a read-only historical Quick replay support snapshot before observing current production-loader parity. The snapshot may support the frozen 16-event House replay-gap extension only if it reproduces the immutable canonical historical matrix for all existing target rows.

requiredState: all ingested Minnesota passage events before the replay cutoff, not only replay targets
dated bill-version corpus used for strict target versions and as-of analogue candidate versions
all decisive member votes on passage events used for analogue member support and chronological member/party/global history
membership session/chamber/party/service-window rows used to construct the active roster
strictly pre-target companion references used by historical analogue relationship logic
loaderContract.importantScopeFinding: Historical analogue retrieval does not impose a chamber filter. A faithful support snapshot therefore cannot be reduced to the 2025-26 House target matrix alone.

snapshotProtocol.environment: Use the repository's established historical-evidence-closeout pattern: pull the production environment privately in GitHub Actions, make read-only database queries, upload an immutable artifact, and delete temporary credentials.
snapshotContents: versionsByBill full dated raw-text/version state required by replay
derived current targetVersionByEvent and analogueSupportByEvent identities/counts for diagnostics

canonicalParityGate.rule: Re-run the current loader/replay and compare every immutable canonical matrix row by voteEventId + membershipId before using the snapshot for extension work.
canonicalParityGate.onMismatch: Fail closed. Do not score any gap16 extension event and do not reinterpret the canonical baseline.
canonicalParityGate.onExtraOrMissingRowKey: Fail closed. The current loader target-row universe must match the immutable canonical matrix exactly.

extensionRule.targetSelectionRule: The frozen 16-event candidate set is immutable; the read-only support snapshot cannot add, remove, or rerank extension targets.
extensionRule.overlayStrategy: Reuse reconciled current loader eventId/billId identities; do not create duplicate synthetic events.

firstReadObservation.observationMeaning: All 16 frozen source-reconstructed events now exist in the current loader even though they were absent from the original frozen target matrix.

reconciliationFields: complete decisive membershipId + legislatorId + choice set
gapEventPresenceGate.unresolvedOutcomePolicy: HF2354|2026-05-17 remains outcome-unresolved for extension scoring even if the mutable database currently contains a passed value.
gapEventPresenceGate.onMismatch: Fail closed. Do not use current loader event/bill IDs or support state for extension work.

knownReadiness.currentLoaderGapEventPresence: 16/16 exact bill/date events observed; reconciliation pending
